agentId.description: An agent whose repository the pull request is of, by its id as list_agents answered it, with number; leave it out to name the repository instead.

repository.description: The repository whose pull request to read, as owner/name, with number; leave it out with agentId.

number.description: The pull request's number, in the repository that repository or agentId names. For an agent's own pull request, pass the number read_agent_changes answers.

workspace.description: With repository, the workspace whose GitHub installation reaches it, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

provider.description: The provider whose API key the member saved to generate on, one of the chaptersProviders list_models answers.
